headline: PROP sector dominated the tape with outsized gap-downs in low-priced names (PF, EVER, CGD) and sharp 5-day leaders (KC, TTCL, PRECHA) demanding RM review.
market_take: Coverage breadth showed clear divergence: 7 of 15 top movers were in PROP, with a split between small-cap downside (PF -20.00%, EVER -14.29%, CGD -10.00% open gap) and speculative upside (NVD +14.29%, PRECHA +11.11%). CONS names were the most disrupted — TRITN opened +50.00% then closed -33.33% intraday, and EMC posted an 82.7σ volume spike. CONMAT was led down by GEL -20.00% on an open gap, while FOOD's moves were largely explainable by named filings (XBIO warrant termination, SNNP fire, TKN buyback).
